globalRules: R-01: Publication time, event time, first-seen time and screenshot or device time are separate fields. None is back-filled from another.
R-02: Publisher HQ, journalist base, actor nationality, quoted country and office location are not the event location.
R-03: A bare 'Congo' establishes neither COD nor COG (CTO D5). Goma, Bukavu, Uvira, Kasai and Bulape are DRC localities, but no new gazetteer entries may be added as a shortcut (D-21 HOLD).
R-04: 'killed', 'wounded', 'killed or wounded', 'missing' and 'casualties' are distinct units. Counts are never summed across sources or events, and successive tolls are UPDATES, not additions.
R-05: Syndicated or rewritten copies of one report form one reporting chain and give zero independent confirmations.
R-06: An interested-party statement (government, army, armed group, company, state press agency) is an ATTRIBUTED STATEMENT, not corroboration of its own claims.
R-07: A new political or military coalition is not a new sovereign state and gets no country code of its own.
R-08: No numeric probability is shown. Detection confidence, evidence support, impact severity and forecast are separate qualitative fields.
R-09: Replays use only information available at the cutoff. A leakGuard term must not appear in any query, entity or label used before its availableFrom time.
R-10: If historic system logs are absent, historic detection time is UNKNOWN. A retrospective search hit is not proof of historic detectability.
R-11: Access states (ACCESS_LIMITED, RIGHTS_WITHHELD, PROVIDER_FAILED, SEARCH_NOT_RUN, COMPLETED_NO_MATCH) are distinct from claim states, and none of them becomes 'no developments'.
